Most people just call an API or use a high-level Hugging Face abstraction. By building the engine yourself, you're learning how to actually *engineer* AI, not just use it.

Keep pushing on this "nano-llama-engine" project. Once it's polished, document it well, maybe write a blog post about the hardest bugs you crushed (like getting the causal mask right or managing KV cache during inference), and put it out there.
